summary: The diff is a complete implementation of Iterator.prototype.windows in its own file. Each spec step is kept as a comment above its code. Argument validation runs in spec order: this-object check, windowSize integral check, range check, undersized check, then GetIteratorDirect. Errors go through IteratorClose where the spec requires it. The closure reproduces step 9: the buffer is kept between yields, the full-window yield closes the iterator on return, and the partial-window yield is discarded on return, with the yielded_partial flag preventing a double action. No test-shaped branches, hardcoded values, swallowed errors, or made-up returns. Gate report shows 80/80 test262 passing with no regressions. I did not see the helper module or ops signatures, so I am relying on the build passing for those. Minor non-spec notes: buffer.remove(0) is O(n) per step, and the string comparisons allocate a Vec each time. Neither affects correctness.
notes_for_next_attempt: No defects found. Optional cleanup: use a VecDeque for the window buffer to avoid O(n) remove(0), and compare undersized strings without allocating a Vec per call.
